scene wearethechildren1
To watch them be restored.
lines.zh: 为了看着它们被复原。

lines.en: : Hear ye, hear ye!
lines.zh: : 听着！听着！

lines.en: : In light of recent developments made to both the protagonist of our video game and the world he inhabits, we, the Plant Council, have reconvened for our 98th meeting.
lines.zh: : 鉴于我们这款电子游戏的主角、以及他所栖居的世界近期出现的新进展，我们植物议会再次召开第 98 次会议。

lines.en: : The topic of today’s discussion will be the significance of S-
lines.zh: : 今天讨论的议题，是那位 S——的重要意义——

lines.en: : Dude, stop. You can’t say her name in front of him. And Plant #2 still isn’t convinced it's her {i}actual{/i} name and it’ll turn into a whole thing that I really don’t have the time for tonight.
lines.zh: : 兄弟，停。你不能当着他的面说出她的名字。而且 2 号植株到现在还不相信那就是她的{i}真名{/i}，到时候又要闹成一团，我今晚可真没那个时间。

lines.en: : Okay, first off, what else could {i}you{/i} possibly be doing tonight?
lines.zh: : 好，首先，{i}你{/i}今晚还能有什么别的事要忙？

lines.en: : Your mother. Ayooo.
lines.zh: : 你妈。哎哟哟。

lines.en: : Plant #4, that was inappropriate and I am going to have to ask that you maintain your best behavior during tonight’s meeting.
lines.zh: : 4 号植株，那句话不得体，我必须要求你在今晚的会议上保持最良好的举止。

lines.en: : Thank you. Now, to get back to what I was about to say, there is an entire {i}truckload{/i} of contradictory evidence supporting-
lines.zh: : 谢谢。那么，回到我刚要说的话——有整整{i}一卡车{/i}的互相矛盾的证据支持——

lines.en: : It was her NAME PLATE, bro! Come on!
lines.zh: : 那是她的铭牌啊，兄弟！拜托！

lines.en: : It’s on the grave and everything!
lines.zh: : 连墓碑上都刻着呢！

lines.en: : But that doesn’t explain the several {i}other{/i} instances where-
lines.zh: : 可那解释不了{i}其他{/i}好几处——

lines.en: : Oh God, here we go again. Or is it {i}god?{/i} I never know which capitalization I’m supposed to use in this game as it fluctuates more than Ami’s personality. Somebody gimme five.
lines.zh: : 哦天啊，又来了。还是说"{i}神{/i}"？我从来搞不清这游戏里该用哪种大小写，它变得比 Ami 的性格还快。谁来跟我击个掌。

lines.en: : We are plants. We can not high five.
lines.zh: : 我们是植物。我们没法击掌。

lines.en: : That really is one of the worst parts of not being a human.
lines.zh: : 这真的是"不是人类"最糟糕的地方之一。

lines.en: : Speaking of humans, I’d like to welcome tonight’s very special guest — Yomiel, who has come face to face with Sensei on several occasions now.
lines.zh: : 说到人类，我想欢迎今晚的特别嘉宾——Yomiel，他迄今为止已经和老师面对面见过好几次了。

lines.en: : Sup, Yomiel.
lines.zh: : 哟，Yomiel。

lines.en: : That human looks a lot like a rabbit to me.
lines.zh: : 在我看来，那个人类很像一只兔子。

lines.en: : {i}Perception,{/i} bro. Go replay Down the Rabbit Hole and get back to me. There’s a whole thing about it.
lines.zh: : 这是{i}认知{/i}问题，兄弟。去重玩一遍《Down the Rabbit Hole》再来找我。那里面有一整套说法。

lines.en: : But then why wasn’t the event called Down the Human Hole?
lines.zh: : 那为什么那个事件不叫《Down the Human Hole》？

lines.en: : I’m about to start a petition to remove {i}both{/i} of you if you do not simmer down. Do either one of you want to be the next Plant #3?
lines.zh: : 你们俩要是再不安分点，我就要发起请愿把你们{i}都{/i}除名了。你们有谁想成为下一任 3 号植株吗？

lines.en: : No way. I saw what happened to his wife and saplings after he got zapped. I can’t do that to Bethany.
lines.zh: : 绝不。我看到他被电击之后，他妻子和幼苗们的下场了。我不能那么对 Bethany。

lines.en: : Bethany? The one from the phone sex line?
lines.zh: : Bethany？电话性爱热线的那个？

lines.en: : It is a “compassion” hotline. We do other things too.
lines.zh: : 那是"慰藉"热线。我们也做别的事。

lines.en: : Yomiel, your last appearance was several updates ago, but it is my understanding that both you and your brethren are present more than you are actually seen. Is this true?
lines.zh: : Yomiel，你上次出场还是好几个更新之前，但据我所知，你和你的同胞们"在场"的时间远比"被看见"的时间多。这是真的吗？

lines.en: : That would be correct. My family and I have been placed all over this world to both learn and observe. So even if you can not see us, you can assume we are there.
lines.zh: : 没错。我和我的族人被安置在这个世界的各个角落，既为了学习，也为了观察。所以即使你们看不见我们，也可以当作我们就在那里。

lines.en: : Like many other things, it is all a matter of perception. And it is quite possible that today, on the second holiest night of the year, that all of {i}you{/i} will see things that are not actually there either.
lines.zh: : 就像许多别的事情一样，这全是认知的问题。而在一年中第二神圣的这个夜晚，{i}你们{/i}所有人很有可能也会看到一些其实并不在那儿的东西。

lines.en: : And what is it that makes {i}tonight{/i} the second holiest night of the year when it is widely agreed upon that the true birthday of Jesus Christ is not on December 25th, but sometime in the middle of the year?
lines.zh: : 可既然大家普遍认为耶稣基督真正的生日并不是 12 月 25 日，而是在年中的某个时候，那{i}今晚{/i}凭什么是一年中第二神圣的夜晚？

lines.en: : See, that’s the thing, though. The relevancy of Jesus Christ in the landscape of this world is not as strong as it is in others.
lines.zh: : 你看，问题就在这儿。耶稣基督在这个世界格局中的分量，并不像在其他世界里那么重。

lines.en: : We have different gods here. Ones that are a lot more complicated and finicky than some brown dude who wandered the desert, gently fellating his apostles before licking their feet.
lines.zh: : 我们这里有不一样的神。比某个在沙漠里游荡、先温柔地给门徒口交、再舔他们脚的棕色家伙，要复杂得多、难伺候得多。

lines.en: : Speaking of brown people, I’d like to lick Imani’s feet if you know what I’m saying.
lines.zh: : 说到棕色人种，我想舔 Imani 的脚，你懂我意思吧。

lines.en: : Imani is {i}black.{/i} Tsuneyo is the brown one.
lines.zh: : Imani 是{i}黑人{/i}。棕色那个是 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : That’s actually a hotly contested topic but, let’s be real, I’d lick both of them.
lines.zh: : 这其实是个争议很大的话题，不过说实话，两个我都想舔。

lines.en: : Amen.
lines.zh: : 阿门。

lines.en: : Please don’t say “amen” in front of Yomiel. It is religiously insensitive.
lines.zh: : 请不要在 Yomiel 面前说"阿门"。这在宗教上很不得体。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’ve been falling out of favor with my designated god lately anyway and have been thinking of migrating closer to the center.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正我最近已经渐渐失宠于指派给我的那位神了，正考虑往中心迁移一下。

lines.en: : Could you elaborate on that? What makes the position of the other gods any different from yours?
lines.zh: : 你能详细说说吗？其他神的立场跟你的有什么不一样？

lines.en: : It really comes down to subtlety at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 说到底，归根结底还是个"含蓄"的问题。

lines.en: : It just rubs me the wrong way hearing, “TAKE SOMETHING THAT ISN’T YOURS” instead of just silently taking things without really making a big show out of it.
lines.zh: : 听到"去拿不属于你的东西"这种话，我就觉得别扭——与其大张旗鼓，不如悄无声息地拿走。

lines.en: : I see the appeal in both sides. Which is precisely why I was so excited to come here and talk to {i}you{/i} guys about it since I know you’re all unbiased.
lines.zh: : 两边的吸引力我都能理解。这也正是我这么兴奋跑来跟{i}你们{/i}聊这件事的原因——毕竟我知道你们都很公正。

lines.en: : Except for Plant #2 who still thinks Ami’s mom’s name isn’t Sekai.
lines.zh: : 除了 2 号植株，他到现在还认为 Ami 妈妈的名字不是 Sekai。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren2
: Ahh, fuck. Sorry guys.
lines.zh: : 啊，操。抱歉，各位。

lines.en: : Great job, Plant #4. Now he’s upside down.
lines.zh: : 干得漂亮，4 号植株。现在他倒过来了。

lines.en: : Or is it {i}we{/i} who are upside down?
lines.zh: : 还是说，倒过来的是{i}我们{/i}？

lines.en: : I see what you did there.
lines.zh: : 我懂你这一手。

lines.en: : While it is certainly unfortunate that {i}something{/i} is upside down right now, I can forgive Plant #4 for his transgression tonight as she {i}was{/i} meant to be the topic of discussion after all.
lines.zh: : 虽然现在有{i}东西{/i}倒过来确实令人遗憾，但今晚我可以原谅 4 号植株的过失——毕竟她本来{i}就是{/i}本次要讨论的话题。

lines.en: : Finally, some background info. Only had to wait three fucking years.
lines.zh: : 总算来了点背景资料。才他妈等了三年而已。

lines.en: : Hey, we’ve got some bits and pieces in the past. Like the part about her being a popular poet. Or the part about how she wanted to bone kids.
lines.zh: : 嘿，过去我们也得到过一些零碎信息。比如她是个受欢迎的诗人。或者她想跟小孩子们上床那部分。

lines.en: : Oh, speaking of that, did you see that thing in the Discord where Selebus said one of the main girls is a shotacon? Which one do you think it is?
lines.zh: : 哦，说到这个，你看到 Discord 上那件事了吗？Selebus 说主线女孩里有一个是正太控。你觉得是哪个？

lines.en: : I think I’m leaning toward Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 我比较倾向 Nodoka。

lines.en: : Nodoka would fuck anything. She doesn’t count.
lines.zh: : Nodoka 什么都敢上。她不算。

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
: Sorry, boss. Please proceed.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，老大。请继续。

lines.en: : So, we all know that Sekai-
lines.zh: : 那么，我们都知道 Sekai——

lines.en: : SIL.
lines.zh: : SIL。

lines.en: : Hah...we all know that {i}Ami’s mother{/i}-
lines.zh: : 哈……我们都知道 {i}Ami 的母亲{/i}——

lines.en: : If it {i}is{/i} her mother.
lines.zh: : 如果她真{i}是{/i}她母亲的话。

lines.en: : This fucking guy.
lines.zh: : 这他妈的家伙。

lines.en: : ...we all know that the red-haired woman from Sensei’s past can’t remain hidden forever. And the nature of this sudden vacation so far has made it seem like she may be closer than we believe.
lines.zh: : ……我们都知道，老师过去那个红发女人不可能永远藏着。而这次突如其来的度假到目前为止的性质，让人觉得她也许比我们以为的更近。

lines.en: : Yomiel, as a current (yet wavering) member of the Church of New Hope, is there anything you can tell us about the woman who may or may not be named Sekai?
lines.zh: : Yomiel，作为新希望教会现任（尽管动摇中）的成员，关于那个可能是也可能不是叫 Sekai 的女人，你有什么能告诉我们的吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Nothing at all?
lines.zh: : 一点都没有？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : I told you we should have gotten Wormwood. Nobody remembers this guy. He’s a dreg.
lines.zh: : 我说过该找 Wormwood 的。没人记得这家伙。他就是个渣滓。

lines.en: : Hey, I didn’t have to come here. There’s a big party in the forest tonight and sometimes Yasu forgets that we have vision and spreads her legs in a way that lets us see up her skirt.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我本来也不必来这儿。今晚森林里有个大派对，有时候 Yasu 会忘了我们是看得见的，把腿张开成能让我们看进裙底的姿势。

lines.en: : Don’t stick your dick in crazy, man.
lines.zh: : 老兄，别把老二插进疯子里。

lines.en: : Always stick your dick in crazy, man. I’m rooting for you.
lines.zh: : 老兄，永远都要把老二插进疯子里。我挺你。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, I am a being without genitalia and thus can not participate in coital activities. But that doesn’t stop the fantasies.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，我是一个没有生殖器的存在，因此无法参与性交活动。但这并不妨碍幻想。

lines.en: : Well, seeing as Yomiel has nothing to say on tonight’s topic, I guess there’s not much left for us to go off of.
lines.zh: : 好吧，既然 Yomiel 对今晚的议题没什么可说的，那我们大概也没什么可依据的了。

lines.en: : Looks like we’ll have to just keep wondering when the next dreaded SIL appearance is going to be.
lines.zh: : 看来我们只能继续猜，下一次可怕的 SIL 登场会是什么时候。

lines.en: : Yeah, because there’s {i}no way{/i} Sekai’s going to show up tonight or anything.
lines.zh: : 是啊，反正 Sekai 今晚{i}绝对不可能{/i}出现什么的。

lines.en: : Is she?
lines.zh: : 会吗？

lines.en: : Oh no...
lines.zh: : 哦不……

lines.en: : Bro, what do you think the narrator was talking about when they mentioned something being {i}restored?{/i}
lines.zh: : 兄弟，旁白提到"{i}某样东西被复原{/i}"的时候，你觉得他指的是什么？

lines.en: : Dude, I don’t know. It’s impossible to know what the narrator is talking about literally ever. Or who that narrator even {i}is{/i} since there are, like...a bunch of them.
lines.zh: : 老兄，我不知道。旁白到底在说什么，根本是永远都不可能搞懂的。甚至连旁白{i}是谁{/i}都不知道，因为好像有……好多个。

lines.en: : Well, I guess we’ll have to just wait and see.
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来我们只能拭目以待了。

lines.en: : This concludes the 98th meeting of 23rd District’s Plant Council. Thank you to Plant #2, Plant #4, and Yomiel, the human rabbit.
lines.zh: : 第 23 区植物议会第 98 次会议到此结束。感谢 2 号植株、4 号植株，以及 Yomiel——那只人类兔子。

lines.en: : We need to leave.
lines.zh: : 我们得走了。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : We need to leave right now.
lines.zh: : 我们得立刻走。

lines.en: : She is {i}coming.{/i}
lines.zh: : 她{i}来了{/i}。

lines.en: : I’ll have Plant #2’s {i}mom{/i} cumming by the end of the-
lines.zh: : 我会让 2 号植株的{i}妈妈{/i}在年底之前——

lines.en: scene wearethechildren3
Covered in char-broiled lizards, I watch as the funny plants do a funny dance and put an end to their funny show.
lines.zh: 我浑身盖满炭烤蜥蜴，看着那些滑稽的植物跳起滑稽的舞蹈，结束了它们滑稽的表演。

lines.en: I wasn’t able to hear anything they were saying this time as my ability to converse with those who are not human normally only applies to animals.
lines.zh: 这一次我听不到他们在说什么，因为我与人类之外的事物交谈的能力，通常只对动物有效。

lines.en: The lizards move as somewhere beneath their crispy skin, they can still think and feel. But the batter is far too thick and too delicious for their cordless vocal muscles to penetrate.
lines.zh: 蜥蜴在动，在它们酥脆的外皮之下，它们依然能思考、能感受。可那层面糊太厚、太美味，它们无线的发声肌根本穿不透。

lines.en: I hear nothing. Not even the sound of the squares behind me.
lines.zh: 我什么也听不见。连身后那些方块的声音都听不见。

lines.en: I wonder how long it’s been?
lines.zh: 我在想，过了多久了？

lines.en: I wonder how long the show has gone on for?
lines.zh: 我在想，这场表演持续了多久？

lines.en: I wonder when the upside down trees will kiss the rightside up grass and rejoin to form a ground worth walking on?
lines.zh: 我在想，那些倒过来的树什么时候会亲吻正过来的草，重新连成一片值得行走的大地？

lines.en: I wonder when anyone will come to understand my metaphors?
lines.zh: 我在想，什么时候才会有人理解我的隐喻？

lines.en: There is only one person who ever could.
lines.zh: 曾经能理解的人，只有一个。

lines.en: But she is gone now.
lines.zh: 但她现在已经不在了。

lines.en: And she’s never coming back.
lines.zh: 而且她再也不会回来了。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren4
: How can you be so sure of that in a world where nothing is permanent?
lines.zh: : 在一个没有什么是永恒的世界里，你怎么能这么确定？

lines.en: : If the world itself is made for you, what’s stopping it from making {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果这个世界本身就是为你而造的，那又有什么能阻止它再造出一个{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: She’s gone and she’s never coming back.
lines.zh: 她走了，而且她再也不会回来了。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren5
: Only if you give up.
lines.zh: : 只要你放弃，才会如此。

lines.en: : You’re not a {i}quitter,{/i} are you?
lines.zh: : 你不是会{i}半途而废{/i}的人，对吧？

lines.en: : After all we’ve been through, you want to just leave me on my own?
lines.zh: : 在我们一起经历了这一切之后，你就想这么丢下我一个人？

lines.en: : What did I do to deserve that?
lines.zh: : 我做了什么，要遭这种报应？

lines.en: : I loved you, you know? And you can deny it all you want, but you loved me too.
lines.zh: : 我爱过你，你知道吗？你想否认就否认吧，但你也爱过我。

lines.en: : You {i}still{/i} love me.
lines.zh: : 你现在{i}还{/i}爱着我。

lines.en: : You emit a certain scent when you’re aroused. It’s my favorite scent in the world.
lines.zh: : 你动情的时候，会散发出一种特别的气味。那是这世上我最喜欢的味道。

lines.en: : Go on.
lines.zh: : 来吧。

lines.en: : Show me how {i}big{/i} it’s gotten.
lines.zh: : 让我看看它长到{i}多大{/i}了。

lines.en: : Hurt me more than I can hurt myself.
lines.zh: : 把我伤得比我能伤自己更狠。

lines.en: {b}SHE IS GONE AND SHE IS NEVER COMING BACK.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}她走了，她再也不会回来了。{/b}

lines.en: scene wearethechildren6
: Do you think I’m a bad person? That I ever wanted to hurt you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我是个坏人吗？觉得我曾经想伤害你吗？

lines.en: : Because it was {i}you{/i} I loved the most until {i}she{/i} came.
lines.zh: : 因为在{i}她{/i}出现之前，我最爱的人是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Why can’t I be with you two?
lines.zh: : 为什么我不能和你们两个在一起？

lines.en: : It’s cold beneath the surface. I want to feel your warmth.
lines.zh: : 水面之下很冷。我想感受你的温度。

lines.en: : I want those long arms wrapped around me.
lines.zh: : 我想要那双长长的手臂环住我。

lines.en: : I want my flesh stuck to yours. I want our sweat on the bedsheets and your tears on my tongue.
lines.zh: : 我想要我的肉贴着你的肉。我想要我们的汗留在床单上，你的泪落在我的舌尖。

lines.en: : Taste me and make me yours a millionth time.
lines.zh: : 尝尝我，第一百万次把我变成你的。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren9
: Doesn’t it feel nostalgic being in a place like this?
lines.zh: : 待在这样的地方，是不是很有怀旧的感觉？

lines.en: : Where no one can see us for miles and miles and miles...
lines.zh: : 方圆好几英里都没有人能看见我们……

lines.en: : Think of everything we can do.
lines.zh: : 想想我们什么都能做。

lines.en: : How quiet it all is.
lines.zh: : 这一切多安静啊。

lines.en: : A place where no one can judge us.
lines.zh: : 一个没人能评判我们的地方。

lines.en: : Where we are free to be ourselves.
lines.zh: : 我们可以自由地做自己。

lines.en: : Where there’s no pain or consequence or {i}anything.{/i}
lines.zh: : 没有痛苦，没有后果，{i}什么都没有{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s just us.
lines.zh: : 只有我们两个。

lines.en: : It’s what we’ve always wanted.
lines.zh: : 这正是我们一直想要的。

lines.en: : A place where we can be ourselves.
lines.zh: : 一个我们可以做自己的地方。

lines.en: : We can laugh and smile and fuck and sing and waste away our days beneath our favorite trees!
lines.zh: : 我们可以大笑、微笑、做爱、唱歌，在我们最喜欢的树下把日子虚度掉！

lines.en: : This is the life that we were made for. Not the one {i}out there.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们就是为这样的生活而生的。不是{i}外面{/i}那一种。

lines.en: : Bring me back.

: How about we play a game?

lines.en: : It’s one we played when you were little.

lines.en: : One your mother used to play with you.
lines.zh: : 是你妈妈以前陪你玩的那种。

lines.en: : The way you’d smile every time you saw me...it always made my heart skip a beat.
lines.zh: : 你每次看到我时的那个笑容……总让我的心跳漏掉一拍。

lines.en: : I wonder when it was that it started skipping more than one at once?
lines.zh: : 我在想，是从什么时候开始，它一次会漏掉不止一拍的？

: It’s like you haven’t grown a day.
lines.zh: : 你好像一天都没长大过。

lines.en: scene colorbars
scene black
: Sensei. Wake up.
lines.zh: : 老师。醒醒。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren15
: Good morning, sleepyhead. Would you mind explaining why you’re passed out a full three miles away from the inn?
lines.zh: : 早上好，瞌睡虫。你能解释一下，为什么你会昏倒在离旅馆整整三英里远的地方吗？

lines.en: : Makoto?...Futaba?...What’s going on?
lines.zh: : Makoto？……Futaba？……怎么回事？

lines.en: : We were going for a walk and noticed someone sleeping up here, so we wanted to go make sure they were okay, but...we didn’t think it’d be you.
lines.zh: : 我们出来散步，注意到有人睡在这边，就想过去确认一下他没事，可……我们没想到会是你。

lines.en: : What happened? It’s not like you to willingly walk away from a room full of teenage girls.
lines.zh: : 发生什么了？你可不像是会主动从一屋子少女身边走开的人。

lines.en: : I think I was...looking for Yumi or...right- Futaba, Rin wants you to know she’s sorry and that you should come back to the inn.
lines.zh: : 我好像是在……找 Yumi 还是谁……对了——Futaba，Rin 想让你知道她很抱歉，还有你应该回旅馆去。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren16
: I know...I already talked to her.
lines.zh: : 我知道……我已经跟她谈过了。

lines.en: : When? How long have I been asleep?
lines.zh: : 什么时候？我睡了多久？

lines.en: : Well, we have no idea when you went out, but it’s about 1:00 AM right now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们不知道你什么时候出来的，不过现在大约凌晨一点。

lines.en: : Then what are {i}you two{/i} doing three miles away from the inn? You should be asleep.
lines.zh: : 那{i}你们俩{/i}在离旅馆三英里的地方干什么？你们该在睡觉才对。

lines.en: : Wait, let me guess. You’re heading the search party for me.
lines.zh: : 等等，让我猜猜。你们是出来找我的搜寻队。

lines.en: : No, actually. Nobody went out to look for you. In fact, nobody even remembers you exist except for Futaba and me.
lines.zh: : 不，其实没有。没人出来找你。事实上，除了 Futaba 和我，根本没人记得你的存在。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren17
: It’s true. They all seem to believe that Imani has been their teacher all year. And Ami won’t stop bragging about how fun it is to live alone.
lines.zh: : 是真的。她们似乎都以为这一整年的老师一直都是 Imani。而 Ami 还在不停吹嘘一个人住有多好玩。

lines.en: : Okay. I was concerned for half a second, but now I know that you’re fucking with me.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我有半秒钟是担心的，不过现在我知道你们在耍我了。

lines.en: : Do you need help getting up? Can you stand?
lines.zh: : 需要我扶你起来吗？你站得起来吗？

lines.en: scene black
I angle myself upward and dust a mixture of sand and dirt off of my blazer before crossing my legs and thanking the two of them for waking me up.
lines.zh: 我撑起身子，拍掉西装外套上的沙土混合物，然后盘起腿，感谢她们俩把我叫醒。

lines.en: I...have no idea how I made it all the way over here or...why my head suddenly hurts so much...
lines.zh: 我……完全不知道自己是怎么一路走到这儿来的，也不知道……为什么头突然这么疼……

lines.en: But I’m glad that I was discovered before dawn since I doubt anyone would believe literally any explanation I would have come up with for this.
lines.zh: 不过还好我在天亮前被人发现了，因为我怀疑不管我编出什么解释，都不会有人相信。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren18
: It’s a good thing we found you when we did. Because there’s no way anyone would have believed literally any explanation you would have come up with for this.
lines.zh: : 幸好我们及时找到了你。因为不管你编出什么解释，都不可能有人相信的。

lines.en: : Yes, Makoto. I am well aware.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Makoto。我很清楚。

lines.en: : Even I’m having a hard time believing it and I’m here.
lines.zh: : 连我人在现场，都很难相信这事。

lines.en: : It’s one thing to wander off and do your own thing, but...we’re a long way from the inn.
lines.zh: : 自己跑去做自己的事是一回事，可是……这儿离旅馆可远得很。

lines.en: : He must have come to get away from everyone. That’s why we’re here, after all.
lines.zh: : 他一定是想躲开所有人。毕竟我们来这儿也是因为这个。

lines.en: : Mutual hatred for snoring? Who is the culprit?
lines.zh: : 都是因为受不了彼此打呼？罪魁祸首是谁？

lines.en: : It’s nothing like that.
lines.zh: : 完全不是那么回事。

lines.en: : What is it then? What common ground do the two of you share that was strong enough to force you three miles down the beach in the middle of the night? Because if it’s something as boring as reading, I-
lines.zh: : 那是什么？你们俩有什么共同点，强烈到能让你们半夜三更沿着海滩走三英里？要是答案无聊到只是看书什么的，我——

lines.en: : We were having a long, serious discussion about how crazy it is that you’ve been having sex with {i}both{/i} of us. Isn’t that fun?
lines.zh: : 我们在进行一场漫长而严肃的讨论，话题是你同时跟我们{i}两个{/i}人上床这件事有多离谱。是不是很有意思？

lines.en: scene wearethechildren19
: Makoto...
lines.zh: : Makoto……

lines.en: : What? I want to see what he has to say about it.
lines.zh: : 怎么？我想看看他对此有什么说法。

lines.en: : Well, at least I understand why you came all the way over here to talk about that. Not really a great topic to get caught discussing.
lines.zh: : 好吧，至少我明白你们为什么特意跑到这儿来聊这个了。这话题被人撞见确实不太妙。

lines.en: : We’re not doing it for our safety, we’re doing it for yours.
lines.zh: : 我们这么做不是为了自己安危，是为了你的安危。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren20
: We’ve both known...there are “others” for a long time. But it wasn’t until Halloween that we figured out {i}each other{/i} were among those people.
lines.zh: : 我们俩都很早就知道……还有"其他人"。但直到万圣节，我们才弄清楚{i}彼此{/i}也在那些人之中。

lines.en: : Ever since then, we’ve been talking more and airing out our grievances about how fruitless the pursuit of your heart is and how, even knowing that, we can’t keep ourselves away.
lines.zh: : 从那以后，我们聊得更多了，也把心里的委屈都摊开了——追求你的心是多么徒劳，而即便明白这一点，我们还是没法让自己离你远一点。

lines.en: : It’s actually rather pathetic, but...it is what it is.
lines.zh: : 说实话挺可悲的，不过……事情就是这样。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure what I’m supposed to say during a time like this. Normally, when I’m confronted, it’s by one person- not two.
lines.zh: : 我真不确定这种时候该说什么。平时被质问，都是一个人——不是两个。

lines.en: : How calming it is knowing that this is a regular thing for you.
lines.zh: : 知道这对你来说是家常便饭，真让人安心啊。

lines.en: : I didn’t mean it like that.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : Then...how did you mean it, Sensei? Because it seems like Makoto and I believed we were fulfilling the same role as one another in your life and-
lines.zh: : 那……老师，你是什么意思？因为我和 Makoto 似乎都以为，我们在你生命里扮演的是同一个角色，而——

lines.en: scene wearethechildren21
: You two don’t have specific {i}roles.{/i} You’re attractive girls who like me that I can have sex with whenever I want. Of course I’m going to take advantage of that.
lines.zh: : 你们俩没有什么特定{i}角色{/i}。你们就是喜欢我、我想什么时候上就能上的漂亮女孩。我当然要好好利用这一点。

lines.en: : You really do have a way with words, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 老师，你说话真有一套。

lines.en: : That...That’s not {i}all{/i} we are, though...is it?
lines.zh: : 可……可我们不{i}只是{/i}那样……对吧？

lines.en: : There’s obviously more to it than that. But if you’re going to be blunt enough to confront me about this directly, I’m going to be respectful enough to tell it like it is instead of beating around the bush.
lines.zh: : 显然不止那样。但如果你们都坦率到当面质问我了，那我也会拿出相应的尊重，实话实说，而不是拐弯抹角。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren22
: This...isn’t really how I expected this conversation would go...
lines.zh: : 这……跟我预想的对话走向不太一样……

lines.en: : This is {i}exactly{/i} how I expected this conversation would go.
lines.zh: : 这跟我预想的对话走向{i}一模一样{/i}。

lines.en: : Listen, I care about both of you...in ways that transcend the time we spend behind closed doors. But I don’t have some end-all, be-all excuse or explanation for why things are the way they are. They just {i}are.{/i}
lines.zh: : 听着，我在乎你们两个……这种在乎超越了我们在紧闭的门后度过的时光。但我没有什么万能的借口或解释，能说明事情为什么会是现在这样。它{i}就是{/i}这样的。

lines.en: : If that makes you want to stop what we’re doing, fine. I don’t blame you. I know that nothing good can last forever.
lines.zh: : 如果这让你们想停下我们之间的事，可以。我不怪你们。我知道好事不可能永远持续。

lines.en: : But I also know there’s never been a point in either one of the relationships I’ve had with you two where some brand of exclusivity was guaranteed or even {i}expected.{/i} Am I right?
lines.zh: : 但我也知道，在我和你们俩的任何一段关系里，从来没有任何时候保证过、甚至{i}期待{/i}过某种独占。我说得对吗？

lines.en: scene wearethechildren23
: Yeah...of course I’m-
lines.zh: : 是啊……我当然——

lines.en: : And don’t “Of course I’m not enough” me when your self-confidence is finally starting to take a turn in the right direction.
lines.zh: : 别在我面前来那套"我当然不够好"——你的自信好不容易才开始往好的方向转。

lines.en: : I’ve just accepted that-
lines.zh: : 我只是接受了——

lines.en: : Don’t you go self-deprecating either, Makoto.
lines.zh: : Makoto，你也别自暴自弃。

lines.en: : I get that you’re going through a tough time, but if you keep blaming your shitty mental state on the same one thing for the rest of your life, you’re going to wind up like me.
lines.zh: : 我知道你现在日子不好过，但如果你这辈子都一直把糟糕的精神状态归咎于同一件事，你最后就会变得跟我一样。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren24
: How did this turn into {i}us{/i} being lectured?
lines.zh: : 怎么变成{i}我们俩{/i}被说教了？

lines.en: : Because Sensei’s a master manipulator and finds it easier to just make things about {i}other{/i} people instead of ever trying to fix the parts of {i}himself{/i} that are broken.
lines.zh: : 因为老师是个操纵大师，他觉得把话题引到{i}别人{/i}身上，比去修补{i}自己{/i}身上破碎的部分要容易得多。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren21
: Why does anything need fixing in the first place?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，有什么非得修好的？

lines.en: : Why can’t we just accept that things don’t need to be in perfect shape in order for us to use them on a daily basis?
lines.zh: : 为什么我们就不能接受——东西不必完美无缺，我们也能天天拿来用？

lines.en: : You’re sleeping with us...{i}because{/i} we’re imperfect?
lines.zh: : 你跟我们上床……{i}是因为{/i}我们不够完美？

lines.en: : That is definitely not what I was going for, but...sure.
lines.zh: : 这绝对不是我想表达的意思，不过……行吧。

lines.en: : Futaba, I told you a long time ago that I’d never be able to accept your feelings until you started thinking better of yourself.
lines.zh: : Futaba，我很久以前就告诉过你，除非你开始把自己看得更好，否则我永远无法接受你的感情。

lines.en: : And Makoto, I’ve made {i}several{/i} pledges to treat you better after directly acknowledging just how much I’ve taken advantage of you.
lines.zh: : 而 Makoto，在正视自己占了你多少便宜之后，我做过{i}好几次{/i}要好对待你的承诺。

lines.en: : Right, and...when is that going to start, exactly? Because things don’t seem very different right now, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那么……这到底什么时候才会开始？因为现在看来一切没什么不同啊，老师。

lines.en: : They {i}are{/i} though.
lines.zh: : {i}其实{/i}不一样。

lines.en: : I hide from everything. It’s what I do. But I’m owning up and trying to explain myself right now.
lines.zh: : 我什么都躲。这就是我的作风。可我现在正在坦承，正在试着解释自己。

lines.en: : My apologies if my explanation isn’t {i}perfect{/i} but it’s kind of hard to justify my stance as an adult male simultaneously screwing two high school girls who are supposed to be able to depend on me.
lines.zh: : 如果我的解释不够{i}完美{/i}，我道歉，但一个成年男人同时和两个本该可以依赖他的高中女生上床，这种立场确实不太好自圆其说。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren25
: That’s just the thing, though. We {i}do{/i} still depend on you. That’s why we’re finding solace in one another instead of spilling your secrets out to the entire class.
lines.zh: : 可问题就在这儿。我们{i}确实{/i}仍然依赖着你。所以我们才在彼此身上寻求慰藉，而不是把你的秘密抖给全班听。

lines.en: : Makoto’s right. We trust you, Sensei. Just...not when it comes to...monogamous relationships.
lines.zh: : Makoto 说得对。我们信任你，老师。只是……在……一夫一妻的关系这件事上除外。

lines.en: : It’s quite possible that’s one more side effect of your manipulation tactics and that we’re simply just too codependent at this point to function {i}without{/i} a change in the details of our relationship...
lines.zh: : 很有可能这也是你那些操纵手段的又一个副作用，而我们到这一步已经太过相互依赖，{i}不{/i}调整关系的细节就没法正常运转了……

lines.en: : But I digress.
lines.zh: : 不过我跑题了。

lines.en: : That didn’t sound like much of a digression to me.
lines.zh: : 我听着可一点都不像跑题。

lines.en: : I think...what Makoto is trying to say is that...it’s okay. We’re not mad.
lines.zh: : 我想……Makoto 想说的是……没关系。我们没有生气。

lines.en: : We’re just a little...confused because we want to understand you better.
lines.zh: : 我们只是有点……困惑，因为我们想更懂你。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren26
: That’s not entirely true. I’m mad. But growing up in a household where probably over one hundred people have had sex has made me rather jaded and I am now monogamy’s biggest fan. Sorry, Mom.
lines.zh: : 这不完全是真的。我在生气。但在可能有上百个人做过爱的家庭里长大，让我变得相当麻木，而我现在成了"一夫一妻制"的头号粉丝。抱歉了，妈妈。

lines.en: : But...you do want to understand Sensei a little more, right?
lines.zh: : 不过……你确实想多了解老师一点，对吧？

lines.en: : That part is right, yes.
lines.zh: : 这部分是对的，没错。

: But why?
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？

lines.en: : I strung you along...used you for my own benefit...lied to you...manipulated you...
lines.zh: : 我吊着你们……为了自己的好处利用你们……对你们撒谎……操纵你们……

lines.en: : I did everything wrong...
lines.zh: : 我把一切都做错了……

lines.en: : You’re not supposed to like me. It’s supposed to be the other way around...
lines.zh: : 你们不该喜欢我的。应该是反过来的才对……

lines.en: : Is that what you want? To be abhorred? To be condemned?
lines.zh: : 那就是你想要的吗？被憎恶？被谴责？

lines.en: : I...I obviously don’t like the...idea of sharing you, but...but if that’s the price I have to pay for the way you make me feel...I can handle that.
lines.zh: : 我……我当然不喜欢……和别人分享你这个主意，可是……可如果这是你给我的感受所必须付出的代价……我能承受。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I can. But at this point, who the fuck even cares? I’ve already been through the worst. I’m pretty sure I can handle whatever comes next.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我能不能。但事到如今，谁他妈还在乎呢？最糟的我都经历过了。接下来无论发生什么，我大概都扛得住。

lines.en: : I don’t get it...
lines.zh: : 我不明白……

lines.en: : I don’t get any of you.
lines.zh: : 你们我一个都不懂。

lines.en: : Why do you keep coming back to me?
lines.zh: : 为什么你们总要回到我身边？

lines.en: : Why did you wake me up?
lines.zh: : 你们为什么叫醒我？

lines.en: : Because you woke {i}us{/i} up.
lines.zh: : 因为你叫醒了{i}我们{/i}。

lines.en: scene wearethechildren28
: From how boring life used to be...
lines.zh: : 从生活曾经有多无聊之中……

lines.en: : From how hopeless it all felt...
lines.zh: : 从一切曾多么令人绝望之中……

lines.en: : And all it took was your last shred of your dignity and a few carefully-tailored words fit for us and us alone.
lines.zh: : 而你所付出的，不过是你最后一丝尊严，和几句专为我们量身定做的话。

lines.en: : We need you just as much as you need us.
lines.zh: : 我们需要你，就像你需要我们一样。

lines.en: : You’re wrong...
lines.zh: : 你错了……

lines.en: : I don’t need you at all.
lines.zh: : 我根本不需要你们。

lines.en: : You don’t need {i}me{/i} at all.
lines.zh: : 你们根本不需要{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : Don’t tell us what we do and don’t need when you’ve been wrong time and time again.
lines.zh: : 你自己一错再错，就别来告诉我们需不需要。

lines.en: : That’s right. Let us follow you in our own way...
lines.zh: : 没错。让我们用自己的方式跟着你……

lines.en: : Because the two of us are smart enough to step back if we ever think we might be wrong...
lines.zh: : 因为我们俩够聪明，一旦觉得自己可能错了，就懂得退后一步……

lines.en: : いない。。。いない。。。
lines.zh: : いない。。。いない。。。

lines.en: : Will it count?! Will it stick?! Our holiday trick?!
lines.zh: : 算数吗？！会成功吗？！我们这节日恶作剧？！

lines.en: : Will they cry?! Will they scream?! Will they bite off his dick?!

lines.en: scene black
: The things that he is owed! We’ll capture them ourselves!
lines.zh: : 他欠下的东西！我们要亲手抓回来！

lines.en: : Shrink them down to our size and mount them on his shelves!
lines.zh: : 把它们缩成我们的尺寸，再挂到他的架子上！

lines.en: : Rejoice! Reclaim the rightful blood!
lines.zh: : 欢庆吧！夺回理应属于我们的血！

lines.en: : We’ve finally done something good!

scene wearethechildren21
: But why?
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？

lines.en: : I strung you along...used you for my own benefit...lied to you...manipulated you...
lines.zh: : 我吊着你们……为了自己的好处利用你们……对你们撒谎……操纵你们……

lines.en: : I did everything wrong...
lines.zh: : 我把一切都做错了……

lines.en: : You’re not supposed to like me. It’s supposed to be the other way around...
lines.zh: : 你们不该喜欢我的。应该是反过来的才对……

lines.en: : Is that what you want? To be abhorred? To be condemned?
lines.zh: : 那就是你想要的吗？被憎恶？被谴责？

lines.en: : I...I obviously don’t like the...idea of sharing you, but...but if that’s the price I have to pay for the way you make me feel...I can handle that.
lines.zh: : 我……我当然不喜欢……和别人分享你这个主意，可是……可如果这是你给我的感受所必须付出的代价……我能承受。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I can. But at this point, who the fuck even cares? I’ve already been through the worst. I’m pretty sure I can handle whatever comes next.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我能不能。但事到如今，谁他妈还在乎呢？最糟的我都经历过了。接下来无论发生什么，我大概都扛得住。

lines.en: : I don’t get it...
lines.zh: : 我不明白……

lines.en: : I don’t get any of you.
lines.zh: : 你们我一个都不懂。

lines.en: : Why do you keep coming back to me?
lines.zh: : 为什么你们总要回到我身边？

lines.en: : Why did you wake me up?
lines.zh: : 你们为什么叫醒我？

lines.en: scene black
: Because you woke {i}us{/i} up...and it’s only fair if we do the same for you.
lines.zh: : 因为你叫醒了{i}我们{/i}……我们以同样的方式回报你，也才公平。

lines.en: : Just go back to sleep...
lines.zh: : 睡吧……

lines.en: I escape the firm, wet grasp of evil hands and return to the inn with two girls by my side.
lines.zh: 我从那双邪恶之手紧实而湿润的掌握中挣脱，带着两个女孩回到旅馆。

lines.en: They escape something else.
lines.zh: 她们逃脱的是别的东西。

lines.en: No one hears or sees us come in.
lines.zh: 没有人听见或看见我们进来。

lines.en: And I sleep facing down in a bed that smells of cherry blossoms.
lines.zh: 我趴在一张散发着樱花气味的床上睡去。

lines.en: I don’t deserve their love.
lines.zh: 我配不上她们的爱。
